NAME:
   rancher cluster - Scale a machine pool, manage cluster-autoscaler settings, upgrade the Kubernetes version of a cluster or take an etcd snapshot (create a provisioning cluster with `rancher create cluster` and delete it with `rancher delete provisioning-cluster`)

USAGE:
   rancher cluster [command [command options]]

COMMANDS:
   clear-autoscaling:   [Prime] Turn off autoscaling for a machine pool
   pause-autoscaling:   [Prime] Pause the cluster autoscaler cluster-wide
   resume-autoscaling:  [Prime] Resume the cluster autoscaler cluster-wide
   save-etcd-snapshot:  Take an etcd snapshot of an RKE2 or K3s cluster
   scale:               Change the number of nodes in a machine pool
   set-autoscaling:     [Prime] Turn on autoscaling for a machine pool
   upgrade:             Upgrade the Kubernetes version of an RKE2 or K3s cluster

OPTIONS:
   --help, -h  show help

GLOBAL OPTIONS:
   --allow-deprecated          allow writing to a deprecated resource
   --apply                     apply the change
   --color string              auto|always|never
   --config string, -c string  path to the config directory [$RANCHER_CLI_CONFIG_DIR]
   --debug                     print telemetry upload details on stderr (development builds)
   --dry-run                   preview the changes without applying them
   --no-input                  never prompt; fail with an error when the input is ambiguous
   --output string, -o string  table|wide|json|yaml|name|template=<go-template>
   --read-only                 refuse commands that make changes in this run; once set it cannot be turned off; local commands do not accept it
   --yes                       confirm a destructive change
